```{r}
# Load the data with tab separator
# see what sheets exist (optional)
excel_sheets("<LOCAL_PATH>")

# read the first (or named) sheet
deer_data <- read_excel(
  path = "<LOCAL_PATH>",
  sheet = 1,              # or "SheetName"
  .name_repair = "unique" # make duplicate column names unique
)

# Check for missing values in critical columns
sum(is.na(deer_data$AID)) # Good
sum(is.na(deer_data$Latitude)) # 32 missing values
sum(is.na(deer_data$Longitude)) #32 missing values
sum(is.na(deer_data$DOP)) #Good
sum(is.na(deer_data$Date_Time)) #Good
# Count unique AIDs
length(unique(deer_data$AID))

# Convert DATE_TIME to POSIXct
deer_data$datetime <- as.POSIXct(deer_data$Date_Time, format="%m/%d/%Y %H:%M")

# Check structure of the data
str(deer_data)

# Clean rows where LATITUDE or LONGITUDE are NA
deer_data_clean <- deer_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(Latitude) & !is.na(Longitude))

# Verify that the DOP column is still present
if(!"DOP" %in% colnames(deer_data_clean)) {
  stop("DOP column is missing after cleaning.")
}

# Ensure LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, and DOP are numeric
deer_data_clean <- deer_data_clean %>%
  mutate(
    LATITUDE = as.numeric(Latitude),
    LONGITUDE = as.numeric(Longitude),
    DOP = as.numeric(DOP)
  )

# Create sf object while keeping the DOP column
deer_data_clean_sf <- st_as_sf(
  deer_data_clean, 
  coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), 
  crs = 4326, remove=FALSE
)

# Transform to UTM Zone 13N (EPSG:32613)
deer_data_clean_utm <- st_transform(deer_data_clean_sf, crs = 32613)

# Extract UTM coordinates and add them as new columns
deer_data_clean <- deer_data_clean %>%
  mutate(
    UTM_EASTING = st_coordinates(deer_data_clean_utm)[,1],
    UTM_NORTHING = st_coordinates(deer_data_clean_utm)[,2]
  )

# Inspect cleaned data
head(deer_data_clean)

# Check structure to ensure DOP is preserved
str(deer_data_clean)
# Check the data type of AID
class(deer_data_clean$AID)

# Count unique AIDs
length(unique(deer_data_clean$AID))

# Count unique non-missing AIDs
n_distinct(deer_data_clean$AID, na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r}
## Checking number of AIDs for column addition for Male and Female
length(unique(deer_filtered_df$AID))

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# 🔹 1) List all yearly files
paths <- c(
  "<LOCAL_PATH>",
  "<LOCAL_PATH>",
  "<LOCAL_PATH>",
  "<LOCAL_PATH>",
  "<LOCAL_PATH>"
)

# 🔹 2) Helper to read ONE file using header-detect logic + add year
read_status_file <- function(status_path) {
  
  tmp <- readxl::read_excel(status_path, col_names = FALSE)

  header_row <- which(apply(tmp, 1, function(r) {
    any(grepl("\\bAID\\b|Animal\\s*ID|Deer\\s*ID", r, ignore.case = TRUE))
  }))[1]

  if (is.na(header_row)) {
    stop(paste("Couldn't find AID-like header in:", status_path))
  }

  status <- readxl::read_excel(status_path, skip = header_row - 1)
  nms <- names(status)

  aid_col <- nms[grepl(
    "^AID$|Animal\\s*ID|Deer\\s*ID|^aid$|animal_?id|deer_?id",
    nms,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )][1]

  sex_col <- nms[grepl(
    "^Sex$|^sex$",
    nms,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )][1]

  cwd_col <- nms[grepl(
    "CWD\\s*Status|CWD.*Result|^Status$|^Result$|cwd.*status|cwd.*result",
    nms,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )][1]

  if (any(is.na(c(aid_col, cwd_col)))) {
    stop(paste0(
      "Couldn't auto-detect AID or CWD Status in: ", status_path,
      "\nColumns detected: ", paste(nms, collapse = " | ")
    ))
  }

  year <- as.integer(stringr::str_extract(basename(status_path), "\\b20\\d{2}\\b"))

  status_clean <- tolower(as.character(status[[cwd_col]]))

  status_norm <- dplyr::case_when(
    stringr::str_detect(status_clean, "pos|positive|detect|detected|reactor") ~ "positive",
    stringr::str_detect(status_clean, "suspect|suspicious")                  ~ "suspect",
    stringr::str_detect(status_clean, "neg|negative|not.*detected|nd")       ~ "negative",
    TRUE                                                                     ~ status_clean
  )

  tibble::tibble(
    AID        = stringr::str_trim(as.character(status[[aid_col]])),
    Sex        = if (!is.na(sex_col)) as.character(status[[sex_col]]) else NA_character_,
    cwd_status = status_norm,
    year       = year
  )
}

# 🔹 3) Read all years and combine
status_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(paths, read_status_file))

# Normalize and keep only IDs like A00 / F00 / F000
status_all <- status_all %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    AID = as.character(AID) |>
      stringr::str_to_upper() |>
      stringr::str_replace_all("[^A-Z0-9]", ""),
    is_id_like = stringr::str_detect(AID, "^[AF][0-9]{2,3}$")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(AID != "", is_id_like) %>%
  dplyr::select(-is_id_like)

# Normalize movement dataframe AID before joining
deer_filtered_df <- deer_filtered_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    AID = as.character(AID) |>
      stringr::str_to_upper() |>
      stringr::str_replace_all("[^A-Z0-9]", "")
  )

# 🔹 4) Choose FINAL status per AID
# Rule: latest year wins; if same year has multiple rows, prefer higher severity.
severity_rank <- function(x) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    x == "positive" ~ 3L,
    x == "suspect"  ~ 2L,
    x == "negative" ~ 1L,
    TRUE            ~ 0L
  )
}

status_final <- status_all %>%
  dplyr::mutate(sev = severity_rank(cwd_status)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(AID, dplyr::desc(year), dplyr::desc(sev)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(AID) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(
    AID,
    `CWD Status` = cwd_status,
    year_final = year
  )

# 🔹 5) Choose stable Sex per AID
# Prefer Sex from latest year with a non-NA value.
sex_latest <- status_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Sex) & stringr::str_trim(Sex) != "") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(AID, dplyr::desc(year)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(AID) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Sex_latest = dplyr::first(Sex),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Fallback: most frequent Sex per AID
sex_mode <- status_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Sex) & stringr::str_trim(Sex) != "") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(AID, Sex) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(AID, dplyr::desc(n)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(AID) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(AID, Sex_mode = Sex)

sex_final <- sex_latest %>%
  dplyr::full_join(sex_mode, by = "AID") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Sex = dplyr::if_else(
      !is.na(Sex_latest),
      Sex_latest,
      Sex_mode
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(AID, Sex)

# 🔹 6) Merge final status + sex
status_final2 <- status_final %>%
  dplyr::left_join(sex_final, by = "AID") %>%
  dplyr::select(AID, Sex, `CWD Status`, year_final)

# Join to movement data
deer_filtered_df <- deer_filtered_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(status_final2, by = "AID")

# 🔹 7) QA
cat("Unique AIDs in movement data: ", dplyr::n_distinct(deer_filtered_df$AID), "\n")
cat("AIDs with any status record:   ", dplyr::n_distinct(status_all$AID), "\n")
cat("AIDs with final status:        ", dplyr::n_distinct(status_final2$AID), "\n")
cat(
  "Rows missing Sex/CWD Status:   ",
  sum(is.na(deer_filtered_df$Sex) | is.na(deer_filtered_df$`CWD Status`)),
  "\n"
)

# Which AIDs in movement lack any status across years?
missing_status_aids <- setdiff(
  unique(deer_filtered_df$AID),
  unique(status_final2$AID)
)

cat("\nFirst 20 movement AIDs missing statu<LOCAL_PATH>")
print(head(missing_status_aids, 20))

# Print final AID status table
aid_status <- status_final2 %>%
  dplyr::select(AID, `CWD Status`, year_final, Sex) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(AID)

print(aid_status, n = Inf)

# Optional checks
print(status_final2)
print(colnames(status_final2))
print(deer_filtered_df)

```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(amt)
library(sf)
library(adehabitatLT)
library(ctmm)
library(patchwork)
library(tidyterra)

## Set ggplot theme
theme_set(theme_bw())

## Write function to subset and convert to ltraj
# Will need this for segmenting migration
lv_func <- function(x, id_, lmin=30) {
  
  # Subset by ID
  temp <- x |> 
    # Filter by ID
    filter(id==id_) |>
    # Select only columns we need to converting back to ltraj
    dplyr::select(id:date) |>
    # Convert to data.frame
    as.data.frame() |>
    # Make date a POSIX-formatted column
    mutate(date = as.POSIXct(date, tz="America/Denver"))
  
  # Convert to ltraj
  ltr <- as.ltraj(xy=temp[,c("x","y")], date=temp$date, id=temp$id)
  
  # Run lavielle
  lv <- lavielle(ltr, Lmin=lmin, which="R2n", Kmax=10, plotit=TRUE)
  
  k_try <- chooseseg(lv, S=0.75, output="opt", draw=TRUE)
  
  print("Optimal breaks by chooseseg():")
  print(k_try)
  
  # Plot and segment with select value of breaks
  fp <- findpath(lv, k_try)
  
  # Take input from the console on number of breaks
  print("Enter number of breaks:")
  k <- scan(n = 1)
  
  # Plot and segment with select value of breaks
  fp <- findpath(lv, k)
  
  # Convert to data frame
  df <- ld(fp)
  # remove some columns we don't need (i.e. match pigs_res)
  df <- df |> as_tibble() |>
    # reorder columns
    dplyr::select(id, x:rel.angle, burst) |>
    # Remove extra characters ("Segment.") so that we only have a number in the burst column
    mutate(burst=gsub("Segment.", "", burst)) |>
    # Combine ID with the segment number
    unite(key, c("id", "burst"), sep="_", remove=FALSE) |>
    # Reorder columns
    dplyr::select(id, key, x:rel.angle)
  
  # Return segmented data
  return(df)
}

#### Deer ####
# Read in deer location data
deer <- read_csv("<LOCAL_PATH>", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  # build a proper timestamp from existing datetime columns
  mutate(
    timestamp = dplyr::coalesce(
      # prefer 'datetime' if present
      if ("datetime" %in% names(.)) with_tz(datetime, "America/Chicago") else as.POSIXct(NA),
      # else fallback to 'Date_Time'
      if ("Date_Time" %in% names(.)) with_tz(as_datetime(Date_Time), "America/Chicago") else as.POSIXct(NA)
    ),
    month = month(timestamp),
    year  = year(timestamp),
    DeerID = as.character(AID),
    study  = as.character(GroupYr),
    # prefer existing X/Y; else UTM; else Lon/Lat
    X = dplyr::coalesce(
      if ("X" %in% names(.)) as.numeric(X) else NA_real_,
      if ("UTM_EASTING"  %in% names(.)) as.numeric(UTM_EASTING) else NA_real_,
      if ("Longitude"    %in% names(.)) as.numeric(Longitude) else NA_real_
    ),
    Y = dplyr::coalesce(
      if ("Y" %in% names(.)) as.numeric(Y) else NA_real_,
      if ("UTM_NORTHING" %in% names(.)) as.numeric(UTM_NORTHING) else NA_real_,
      if ("Latitude"     %in% names(.)) as.numeric(Latitude) else NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  select(DeerID, study, month, year, timestamp, X, Y)

deer |> group_by(study) |> reframe(range=range(timestamp))

# Create track of all individuals
deer_tr <- make_track(deer, X, Y, timestamp, id=DeerID, crs=32616)

# Check sampling rate of all individuals
trk_info <- deer_tr |> summarize_sampling_rate_many(c("id"), time_unit="min")

# List individual IDs
un.id <- unique(deer$DeerID)

## Loop over each ID and: 
# 1. Resample to every 3 hours
# 2. Calculate step lengths (and find median)
# 3. Check patchiness of location data
# 4. Determine whether individuals are moving ranges throughout the year
# 5. Build ctmm home range
# 6. Extract available points from home range


#### 1. and 2. Run loop to resample and calculate step lengths ####
deer_res <- tibble()
tr_sum   <- tibble()

for (i in seq_along(un.id)) {
  # RAW fixes for this ID (no resampling, no regularization)
  dat <- deer_tr %>%
    filter(id == un.id[i]) %>%
    arrange(t_)
  if (nrow(dat) < 2) next
  
  # (optional) sampling-rate summary
  s <- dat %>% summarize_sampling_rate_many(c("id"), time_unit = "hour")
  tr_sum <- bind_rows(tr_sum, s)
  
  # ltraj from raw coords/times
  df_raw <- as.data.frame(dat)
  ltr    <- as.ltraj(xy = df_raw[, c("x_", "y_")], date = df_raw$t_, id = df_raw$id)
  
  # Extract step metrics
  df_out <- ld(ltr) %>%
    as_tibble()
  
  # If R2n missing, add it as net squared displacement from first point of each burst
  if (!"R2n" %in% names(df_out) || all(is.na(df_out$R2n))) {
    df_out <- df_out %>%
      group_by(id, burst) %>%
      mutate(
        x0  = first(x[!is.na(x)]),
        y0  = first(y[!is.na(y)]),
        R2n = (x - x0)^2 + (y - y0)^2
      ) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      select(-x0, -y0)
  }
  
  # Keep the same column set you used before (this includes R2n now)
  df_out <- df_out %>%
    dplyr::select(id, x:rel.angle)
  
  deer_res <- bind_rows(deer_res, df_out)
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# AFTER YOU COMPUTE df AS YOUR FILTERED DATA
# This locks in the manually removed points
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(lubridate)
library(janitor)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Compute removals
# ------------------------------------------------------------

removed <- anti_join(deer_res0, df, by = ".rid")

total_removed <- nrow(removed)
total_before  <- nrow(deer_res0)
total_after   <- nrow(df)

cat("Total before:", total_before, "\n")
cat("Total after :", total_after,  "\n")
cat("Removed     :", total_removed, sprintf("(%.2f%%)\n", 100 * total_removed / total_before))

removed_by_id <- removed %>%
  count(id, name = "removed_n") %>%
  arrange(desc(removed_n))

print(removed_by_id, n = 50)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Final filtered resident data
# IMPORTANT: this is the object everything below must use
# ------------------------------------------------------------

deer_res <- df %>%
  select(-.rid)

out_path <- "<LOCAL_PATH>"

write_csv(deer_res, out_path)

cat("✅ Saved", nrow(deer_res), "rows to:", out_path, "\n")

# ============================================================
# ENRICH ONLY THE FILTERED DATA
# Do NOT go back to deer_res0 or old objects
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Normalize filtered deer_res
# ------------------------------------------------------------

deer_res_norm <- deer_res %>%
  mutate(
    id = trimws(as.character(id)),
    date = as.POSIXct(
      format(as.POSIXct(date, tz = "UTC"), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
      tz = "UTC"
    ),
    x = round(as.numeric(x), 4),
    y = round(as.numeric(y), 4)
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Normalize original metadata table
# ------------------------------------------------------------

deer_filtered_norm <- deer_filtered_df %>%
  mutate(
    AID = trimws(as.character(AID)),
    
    Date_Time = dplyr::coalesce(
      if (inherits(datetime, "POSIXt")) {
        as.POSIXct(datetime, tz = "UTC")
      } else {
        as.POSIXct(NA)
      },
      suppressWarnings(as.POSIXct(Date_Time, tz = "UTC"))
    ),
    
    Date_Time = as.POSIXct(
      format(Date_Time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
      tz = "UTC"
    ),
    
    X = round(as.numeric(X), 4),
    Y = round(as.numeric(Y), 4)
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Columns to bring over
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cols_to_add <- c(
  "FixNum",
  "GroupYr",
  "Latitude",
  "Longitude",
  "Altitude",
  "FixStatus",
  "NumSats",
  "DOP",
  "LATITUDE",
  "LONGITUDE",
  "UTM_EASTING",
  "UTM_NORTHING",
  "Sex",
  "CWD Status",
  "year_final"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Enrich filtered data only
# ------------------------------------------------------------

deer_res_joined <- deer_res_norm %>%
  left_join(
    deer_filtered_norm %>%
      select(AID, Date_Time, X, Y, any_of(cols_to_add)),
    by = c(
      "id" = "AID",
      "date" = "Date_Time",
      "x" = "X",
      "y" = "Y"
    )
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Diagnostics
# ------------------------------------------------------------

n_total <- nrow(deer_res_norm)

n_matched <- sum(
  !is.na(deer_res_joined$GroupYr) |
    !is.na(deer_res_joined$Sex) |
    !is.na(deer_res_joined$FixNum)
)

cat("Joined rows matched:", n_matched, "of", n_total,
    sprintf("(%.2f%%)\n", 100 * n_matched / max(1, n_total)))

cat("Rows after join:", nrow(deer_res_joined), "\n")

if (nrow(deer_res_joined) != nrow(deer_res)) {
  warning("The join changed the row count. That means duplicate matches may exist in deer_filtered_df.")
}

# ============================================================
# SAFETY CHECK:
# Make sure removed rows are NOT in deer_res_joined
# ============================================================

removed_check <- removed %>%
  mutate(
    id = trimws(as.character(id)),
    date = as.POSIXct(
      format(as.POSIXct(date, tz = "UTC"), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
      tz = "UTC"
    ),
    x = round(as.numeric(x), 4),
    y = round(as.numeric(y), 4)
  ) %>%
  semi_join(
    deer_res_joined,
    by = c("id", "date", "x", "y")
  )

cat("Removed points still present after join:", nrow(removed_check), "\n")

if (nrow(removed_check) > 0) {
  print(
    removed_check %>%
      select(id, date, x, y) %>%
      arrange(id, date),
    n = Inf
  )
  
  stop("Some manually removed points are still present. The filtered object was not used correctly.")
}

# ============================================================
# SAVE FILTERED + ENRICHED DATA
# ============================================================

write_csv(
  deer_res_joined,
  "<LOCAL_PATH>"
)

# ============================================================
# RECALCULATE MOVEMENT COLUMNS AFTER FILTERING
# ============================================================

deer_recalc <- deer_res_joined %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(
    id = as.character(id),
    
    date = parse_date_time(
      as.character(date),
      orders = c(
        "ymd HMS",
        "ymd HM",
        "ymd",
        "mdy HMS",
        "mdy HM",
        "mdy"
      ),
      tz = "UTC"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(id, date)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Choose coordinate columns
# ------------------------------------------------------------

coord_x <- "utm_easting"
coord_y <- "utm_northing"

# If UTM columns are missing or NA, use x/y instead:
# coord_x <- "x"
# coord_y <- "y"

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Recalculate movement
# ------------------------------------------------------------

deer_recalc <- deer_recalc %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  arrange(date, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    fix_num_recalc = row_number(),
    
    x_prev = lag(.data[[coord_x]]),
    y_prev = lag(.data[[coord_y]]),
    date_prev = lag(date),
    
    dx_recalc = .data[[coord_x]] - x_prev,
    dy_recalc = .data[[coord_y]] - y_prev,
    
    dist_recalc = sqrt(dx_recalc^2 + dy_recalc^2),
    
    dt_recalc = as.numeric(difftime(date, date_prev, units = "hours")),
    
    speed_m_per_hr = dist_recalc / dt_recalc,
    
    abs_angle_recalc = atan2(dy_recalc, dx_recalc),
    
    rel_angle_recalc = abs_angle_recalc - lag(abs_angle_recalc),
    rel_angle_recalc = atan2(
      sin(rel_angle_recalc),
      cos(rel_angle_recalc)
    ),
    
    x_start = first(.data[[coord_x]]),
    y_start = first(.data[[coord_y]]),
    
    r2n_recalc = (.data[[coord_x]] - x_start)^2 +
      (.data[[coord_y]] - y_start)^2,
    
    net_displacement_km = sqrt(r2n_recalc) / 1000
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

deer_for_classification <- deer_recalc %>%
  mutate(
    dx = dx_recalc,
    dy = dy_recalc,
    dist = dist_recalc,
    dt = dt_recalc,
    abs_angle = abs_angle_recalc,
    rel_angle = rel_angle_recalc,
    r2n = r2n_recalc,
    fix_num = fix_num_recalc
  )

# ============================================================
# PLOT FROM deer_for_classification ONLY
# ============================================================

deer_tracks <- deer_for_classification %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(
    id = as.character(id),
    
    date = parse_date_time(
      as.character(date),
      orders = c(
        "ymd HMS",
        "ymd HM",
        "ymd",
        "mdy HMS",
        "mdy HM",
        "mdy"
      ),
      tz = "UTC"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(.data[[coord_x]]),
    !is.na(.data[[coord_y]]),
    !is.na(id),
    !is.na(date)
  ) %>%
  arrange(id, date)

ids <- sort(unique(deer_tracks$id))

cat("Number of unique IDs:", length(ids), "\n")
print(ids)

# ============================================================
# Function: one deer ID track + R2n plot
# ============================================================

plot_deer_track_r2n <- function(deer_id) {
  
  deer_i <- deer_tracks %>%
    filter(id == as.character(deer_id)) %>%
    arrange(date)
  
  if (nrow(deer_i) == 0) {
    stop(paste("No rows found for ID:", deer_id))
  }
  
  n_fixes <- nrow(deer_i)
  date_min <- min(deer_i$date, na.rm = TRUE)
  date_max <- max(deer_i$date, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  cwd_label <- deer_i %>%
    distinct(cwd_status) %>%
    pull(cwd_status) %>%
    paste(collapse = ", ")
  
  p_track <- ggplot(
    deer_i,
    aes(
      x = .data[[coord_x]],
      y = .data[[coord_y]]
    )
  ) +
    geom_path(linewidth = 0.45, alpha = 0.75) +
    geom_point(aes(color = date), size = 1.2, alpha = 0.85) +
    coord_equal() +
    labs(
      title = paste("Deer ID", deer_id),
      subtitle = paste0(
        "CWD Status: ", cwd_label,
        " | Fixes: ", n_fixes,
        " | ", format(date_min, "%Y-%m-%d"),
        " to ", format(date_max, "%Y-%m-%d")
      ),
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL,
      color = "Date"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
  
  p_r2n <- ggplot(
    deer_i,
    aes(
      x = date,
      y = r2n
    )
  ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.45, alpha = 0.8, na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_point(size = 0.8, alpha = 0.65, na.rm = TRUE) +
    labs(
      title = "R2n over time",
      x = "Date",
      y = "R2n"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
  
  combined_plot <- p_track / p_r2n +
    plot_layout(heights = c(2.2, 1))
  
  return(combined_plot)
}

# ============================================================
# Flip through all deer IDs
# ============================================================

for (deer_id in ids) {
  print(plot_deer_track_r2n(deer_id))
}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)

plot_deer_track_r2n <- function(deer_id, data = deer_tracks) {
  
  deer_i <- data %>%
    mutate(id = trimws(as.character(id))) %>%
    filter(id == trimws(as.character(deer_id))) %>%
    arrange(date)
  
  cat("Rows found:", nrow(deer_i), "\n")
  if (nrow(deer_i) == 0) stop("no rows found for this ID")
  
  if (!"fix_num" %in% names(deer_i)) {
    deer_i <- deer_i %>% mutate(fix_num = row_number())
  }
  
  if (!"migration_status" %in% names(deer_i)) {
    deer_i <- deer_i %>% mutate(migration_status = "Unlabeled")
  }
  
  deer_i <- deer_i %>%
    mutate(
      r2n = as.numeric(r2n),
      net_displacement_km = sqrt(r2n) / 1000
    )
  
  # ---- top plot (movement track) ----
  p1 <- ggplot(deer_i, aes(
    x = utm_easting,
    y = utm_northing,
    color = migration_status,
    text = paste(
      "Date:", date,
      "<br>Fix:", fix_num,
      "<br>Status:", migration_status
    )
  )) +
    geom_path(size = 0.7, alpha = 0.85) +
    coord_equal() +
    labs(
      title = paste("Tracks for ID", deer_id),
      x = NULL, y = NULL,
      color = "Status"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    )
  
  # ---- bottom plot (displacement) ----
  p2 <- ggplot(deer_i, aes(
    x = fix_num,
    y = net_displacement_km,
    color = migration_status,
    text = paste(
      "Date:", date,
      "<br>R2n:", round(r2n, 2),
      "<br>Net Displacement (km):", round(net_displacement_km, 2),
      "<br>Status:", migration_status
    )
  )) +
    geom_line(size = 0.4, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_point(size = 1.3, alpha = 0.85) +
    labs(
      title = "R2n / Net displacement",
      x = "Fix #", y = "Net Displacement (km)",
      color = "Status"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
  
  # Convert both ggplots to plotly
  p1_int <- plotly::ggplotly(p1, tooltip = "text")
  p2_int <- plotly::ggplotly(p2, tooltip = "text")
  
  # Stack vertically (like patchwork)
  fig <- subplot(
    p1_int, p2_int,
    nrows = 2,
    heights = c(0.6, 0.4),
    shareX = FALSE,
    titleY = TRUE
  )
  
  fig
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Split each deer ID into its own Excel file for manual labeling
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(janitor)
library(lubridate)
library(openxlsx)
library(fs)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Clean names and prep data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

deer_split <- deer_res_joined %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(
    id = as.character(id),
    date = parse_date_time(
      date,
      orders = c(
        "ymd HMS", "ymd HM", "ymd",
        "mdy HMS", "mdy HM", "mdy"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(id, date)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Optional: add manual labeling columns
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# These are blank columns you can fill in Excel.

deer_split <- deer_split %>%
  mutate(
    final_class = NA_character_,        # resident / migratory / dispersal
    manual_phase = NA_character_,       # winter_range / summer_range / spring_migration / fall_migration / dispersal
    keep_for_corridor = NA_character_,  # yes / no
    manual_notes = NA_character_
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Create output directory
# ------------------------------------------------------------

out_dir <- "<LOCAL_PATH>"

dir_create(out_dir)

cat("Output directory created at:", out_dir, "\n")

# ============================================================
# 4. Export one Excel file per ID
# ============================================================

ids <- sort(unique(deer_split$id))

for (deer_id in ids) {
  
  deer_i <- deer_split %>%
    filter(id == deer_id) %>%
    arrange(date)
  
  # Clean file-safe ID name
  safe_id <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_-]", "_", deer_id)
  
  out_file <- file.path(
    out_dir,
    paste0("deer_ID_", safe_id, "_manual_labeling.xlsx")
  )
  
  wb <- createWorkbook()
  
  addWorksheet(wb, "track_data")
  
  writeData(
    wb,
    sheet = "track_data",
    x = deer_i
  )
  
  # Freeze top row
  freezePane(
    wb,
    sheet = "track_data",
    firstRow = TRUE
  )
  
  # Add filter
  addFilter(
    wb,
    sheet = "track_data",
    rows = 1,
    cols = 1:ncol(deer_i)
  )
  
  # Auto column widths
  setColWidths(
    wb,
    sheet = "track_data",
    cols = 1:ncol(deer_i),
    widths = "auto"
  )
  
  saveWorkbook(
    wb,
    file = out_file,
    overwrite = TRUE
  )
}

cat("Finished exporting", length(ids), "Excel files to:", out_dir, "\n")
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# Deer spike reviewer — reproducible point removal tracker
# =============================================================================

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(shiny)
library(readr)

# ---- save directory ----------------------------------------------------------
options(deer_cleaner.save_dir = "<LOCAL_PATH>")

# ---- prep once for session ---------------------------------------------------
# IMPORTANT: arrange first, then create stable row id
deer_res_joined <- deer_res_joined %>%
  arrange(id, date) %>%
  mutate(.rid = row_number())

# frozen original snapshot for reproducibility
orig_data <- deer_res_joined

ids_all <- sort(unique(deer_res_joined$id))

# ---- UI ----------------------------------------------------------------------
ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Deer spike reviewer — click/select points to mark/remove"),

  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      selectInput("id", "ID", choices = ids_all),

      actionButton("clear", "Clear current marks"),
      actionButton("remove", "Remove marked from dataset", class = "btn-danger"),
      actionButton("save_now", "Save current cleaned + removal log"),

      hr(),

      verbatimTextOutput("stats"),

      helpText(
        "Tip: Click a point in either plot to toggle mark. 
        Box/lasso select points to toggle multiple marks. 
        Marked points turn red. Removed points are logged permanently."
      )
    ),

    mainPanel(
      fluidRow(
        column(6, plotlyOutput("xy_plot", height = 420)),
        column(6, plotlyOutput("r2n_plot", height = 420))
      ),

      hr(),

      h4("Currently marked points"),
      tableOutput("marked_tbl"),

      hr(),

      h4("Removed points log"),
      tableOutput("removed_tbl")
    )
  )
)

# ---- SERVER ------------------------------------------------------------------
server <- function(input, output, session) {

  rv <- reactiveValues(
    data = deer_res_joined,              # working cleaned copy
    marked = integer(),                  # currently selected .rid values
    removed_rids = integer(),            # all removed .rid values
    removed_log = tibble(),              # full removal log
    removal_batch = 0                    # increments each time remove button is used
  )

  # ---- current ID data --------------------------------------------------------
  cur <- reactive({
    req(input$id)

    rv$data %>%
      filter(id == input$id) %>%
      arrange(date) %>%
      mutate(is_marked = .rid %in% rv$marked)
  })

  # ---- helper: save cleaned data and removed log ------------------------------
  save_outputs <- function(reason = "manual") {

    save_dir <- normalizePath(
      getOption("deer_cleaner.save_dir", tempdir()),
      winslash = "/",
      mustWork = FALSE
    )

    if (!dir.exists(save_dir)) {
      dir.create(save_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    }

    if (file.access(save_dir, 2) != 0) {
      showNotification(
        paste("Save dir not writable:", save_dir, "→ using tempdir()."),
        type = "error"
      )
      save_dir <- tempdir()
    }

    ts <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")

    clean_path <- file.path(
      save_dir,
      sprintf("deer_cleaned_%s_%s.csv", reason, ts)
    )

    removed_path <- file.path(
      save_dir,
      sprintf("deer_removed_log_%s_%s.csv", reason, ts)
    )

    # cleaned working dataset
    tryCatch(
      {
        write_csv(rv$data, clean_path)
      },
      error = function(e) {
        showNotification(
          paste("Cleaned CSV save failed:", conditionMessage(e)),
          type = "error"
        )
      }
    )

    # permanent removal log
    tryCatch(
      {
        write_csv(rv$removed_log, removed_path)
      },
      error = function(e) {
        showNotification(
          paste("Removed-log CSV save failed:", conditionMessage(e)),
          type = "error"
        )
      }
    )

    assign("deer_res_joined_cleaned", rv$data, envir = .GlobalEnv)
    assign("deer_removed_log", rv$removed_log, envir = .GlobalEnv)

    showNotification(
      paste("Saved cleaned data and removal log to:", save_dir),
      type = "message"
    )
  }

  # ---- helper: toggle marks ---------------------------------------------------
  toggle_rids <- function(rids) {
    rids <- unique(as.integer(rids))
    rids <- rids[!is.na(rids)]

    if (!length(rids)) return()

    to_add <- setdiff(rids, rv$marked)
    to_remove <- intersect(rids, rv$marked)

    rv$marked <- union(setdiff(rv$marked, to_remove), to_add)
  }

  # ---- clear current marks ----------------------------------------------------
  observeEvent(input$clear, {
    rv$marked <- integer()
    showNotification("Cleared current marks.", type = "message")
  })

  # ---- remove marked points + permanently log them ----------------------------
  observeEvent(input$remove, {

    if (!length(rv$marked)) {
      showNotification("No points are marked.", type = "warning")
      return()
    }

    # only remove points that still exist in working data
    marked_existing <- intersect(rv$marked, rv$data$.rid)

    if (!length(marked_existing)) {
      rv$marked <- integer()
      showNotification("Marked points were already removed.", type = "warning")
      return()
    }

    rv$removal_batch <- rv$removal_batch + 1
    removal_time <- Sys.time()

    removed_now <- orig_data %>%
      filter(.rid %in% marked_existing) %>%
      mutate(
        removal_batch = rv$removal_batch,
        removal_time = removal_time,
        removed_by_app = TRUE
      ) %>%
      arrange(id, date)

    rv$removed_log <- bind_rows(rv$removed_log, removed_now)
    rv$removed_rids <- union(rv$removed_rids, marked_existing)

    n_removed <- nrow(removed_now)

    # update working dataset
    rv$data <- rv$data %>%
      filter(!.rid %in% marked_existing)

    # clear marks after removal
    rv$marked <- integer()

    # refresh ID choices
    new_ids <- sort(unique(rv$data$id))

    updateSelectInput(
      session,
      "id",
      choices = new_ids
    )

    if (length(new_ids) && !(input$id %in% new_ids)) {
      updateSelectInput(
        session,
        "id",
        selected = new_ids[1]
      )
    }

    # save after each removal for reproducibility
    save_outputs(reason = "auto_after_remove")

    showNotification(
      sprintf(
        "Removed and logged %d point(s). Removal batch: %d.",
        n_removed,
        rv$removal_batch
      ),
      type = "message"
    )
  })

  # ---- manual save button -----------------------------------------------------
  observeEvent(input$save_now, {
    save_outputs(reason = "manual")
  })

  # ---- click selection: XY plot ----------------------------------------------
  observeEvent(event_data("plotly_click", source = "xy_src"), {
    d <- event_data("plotly_click", source = "xy_src")

    if (is.null(d) || is.null(d$customdata)) return()

    toggle_rids(d$customdata)
  }, ignoreInit = TRUE)

  # ---- click selection: R2n plot ---------------------------------------------
  observeEvent(event_data("plotly_click", source = "r2n_src"), {
    d <- event_data("plotly_click", source = "r2n_src")

    if (is.null(d) || is.null(d$customdata)) return()

    toggle_rids(d$customdata)
  }, ignoreInit = TRUE)

  # ---- box/lasso selection: XY plot ------------------------------------------
  observeEvent(event_data("plotly_selected", source = "xy_src"), {
    d <- event_data("plotly_selected", source = "xy_src")

    if (is.null(d) || is.null(d$customdata)) return()

    toggle_rids(d$customdata)
  }, ignoreInit = TRUE)

  # ---- box/lasso selection: R2n plot -----------------------------------------
  observeEvent(event_data("plotly_selected", source = "r2n_src"), {
    d <- event_data("plotly_selected", source = "r2n_src")

    if (is.null(d) || is.null(d$customdata)) return()

    toggle_rids(d$customdata)
  }, ignoreInit = TRUE)

  # ---- XY plot ---------------------------------------------------------------
  output$xy_plot <- renderPlotly({
    df <- cur()

    p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
      geom_path(color = "grey80") +
      geom_point(
        aes(
          color = is_marked,
          customdata = .rid,
          text = paste0(
            "ID: ", id,
            "<br>Date: ", date,
            "<br>.rid: ", .rid,
            "<br>x: ", x,
            "<br>y: ", y
          )
        ),
        size = 1.8
      ) +
      scale_color_manual(
        values = c(`FALSE` = "grey40", `TRUE` = "red"),
        guide = "none"
      ) +
      coord_equal() +
      labs(
        title = paste("XY —", unique(df$id)),
        x = "X",
        y = "Y"
      ) +
      theme_minimal()

    ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text", source = "xy_src") %>%
      layout(
        dragmode = "select",
        clickmode = "event+select"
      ) %>%
      config(displayModeBar = TRUE)
  })

  # ---- R2n plot --------------------------------------------------------------
  output$r2n_plot <- renderPlotly({
    df <- cur()

    p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = date, y = R2n)) +
      geom_line(color = "grey80") +
      geom_point(
        aes(
          color = is_marked,
          customdata = .rid,
          text = paste0(
            "ID: ", id,
            "<br>Date: ", date,
            "<br>.rid: ", .rid,
            "<br>R2n: ", R2n,
            "<br>dist: ", dist,
            "<br>FixStatus: ", FixStatus
          )
        ),
        size = 1.8
      ) +
      scale_color_manual(
        values = c(`FALSE` = "grey40", `TRUE` = "red"),
        guide = "none"
      ) +
      labs(
        title = "R2n over time",
        x = "Time",
        y = "R²n"
      ) +
      theme_minimal()

    ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text", source = "r2n_src") %>%
      layout(
        dragmode = "select",
        clickmode = "event+select"
      ) %>%
      config(displayModeBar = TRUE)
  })

  # ---- currently marked table ------------------------------------------------
  output$marked_tbl <- renderTable({
    if (!length(rv$marked)) {
      return(tibble(
        message = "No points currently marked."
      ))
    }

    rv$data %>%
      filter(.rid %in% rv$marked) %>%
      arrange(id, date) %>%
      select(
        .rid,
        id,
        date,
        x,
        y,
        dist,
        R2n,
        FixStatus
      )
  })

  # ---- removed points table --------------------------------------------------
  output$removed_tbl <- renderTable({
    if (!nrow(rv$removed_log)) {
      return(tibble(
        message = "No points removed yet."
      ))
    }

    rv$removed_log %>%
      arrange(removal_batch, id, date) %>%
      select(
        removal_batch,
        removal_time,
        .rid,
        id,
        date,
        x,
        y,
        dist,
        R2n,
        FixStatus
      )
  })

  # ---- stats ----------------------------------------------------------------
  output$stats <- renderText({
    paste0(
      "Original rows: ", nrow(orig_data),
      "\nCurrent cleaned rows: ", nrow(rv$data),
      "\nCurrent ID rows: ", nrow(cur()),
      "\nCurrently marked: ", length(rv$marked),
      "\nTotal removed: ", length(rv$removed_rids),
      "\nRemoval batches: ", rv$removal_batch
    )
  })
}

# ---- Run app on localhost ----------------------------------------------------
shinyApp(
  ui,
  server,
  options = list(host = "127.0.0.1", port = 8080)
)
```

```{r}
# ── Sliding-window AKDE per article seasonal seg_key ───────────────────────
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(ctmm)
library(lubridate)
library(tibble)
library(purrr)
library(furrr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)

# =============================================================================
# INPUT:
# Use the article-cleaned dataset after migration-corridor removal
# =============================================================================
head(df)
akde_input <- article_df

# =============================================================================
# Params
# =============================================================================

crs_utm     <- 32613
win_days    <- 7
step_days   <- 1
min_fixes   <- 20
tz_analysis <- "UTC"

# =============================================================================
# 0) Normalize article-based seasonal seg_key
#
# OLD:
#   segmented_df
#   burst
#   seg_key = id_seg_burst
#
# NEW:
#   akde_input
#   hr_season = summer/winter
#   hr_season_year = article home-range season year
#   seg_key = id_year_season
# =============================================================================

akde_df <- akde_input %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(x),
    !is.na(y),
    !is.na(date),
    !is.na(id),
    !is.na(hr_season),
    !is.na(hr_season_year)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    id = as.character(id),
    hr_season = as.character(hr_season),
    hr_season_year = as.integer(hr_season_year),
    date = as.POSIXct(date, tz = tz_analysis),

    # Article-based seasonal segment key
    seg_key = paste(id, hr_season_year, hr_season, sep = "_"),

    # Keep CWD / sex metadata if present
    Sex = if ("Sex" %in% names(.)) as.character(Sex) else NA_character_,
    `CWD Status` = if ("CWD Status" %in% names(.)) as.character(`CWD Status`) else NA_character_
  ) %>%
  arrange(seg_key, date)

# QA
cat("\nAKDE input by article seasonal seg_ke<LOCAL_PATH>")
akde_df %>%
  count(seg_key, id, hr_season_year, hr_season, name = "n_fixes") %>%
  arrange(id, hr_season_year, hr_season) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

# Save exact AKDE input
readr::write_csv(
  akde_df,
  file.path(ARTICLE_OUT_DIR, "akde_article_seasonal_input.csv")
)

# =============================================================================
# 1) Build lon/lat for ctmm
# ctmm::as.telemetry expects longitude/latitude
# =============================================================================

seg_sf <- akde_df %>%
  st_as_sf(
    coords = c("x", "y"),
    crs = crs_utm,
    remove = FALSE
  ) %>%
  st_transform(4326)

ll <- st_coordinates(seg_sf) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  rename(
    location.long = X,
    location.lat = Y
  )

tele_df <- akde_df %>%
  select(
    seg_key,
    id,
    hr_season_year,
    hr_season,
    date,
    Sex,
    `CWD Status`
  ) %>%
  bind_cols(ll) %>%
  transmute(
    individual.local.identifier = seg_key,
    id,
    hr_season_year,
    hr_season,
    Sex,
    `CWD Status`,
    location.long,
    location.lat,
    timestamp = with_tz(date, tz_analysis)
  )

# =============================================================================
# 2) Telemetry list keyed by article seasonal seg_key
# =============================================================================

tele_list <- ctmm::as.telemetry(
  tele_df,
  timeformat = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S",
  timezone   = tz_analysis
)

names(tele_list) <- vapply(
  tele_list,
  function(x) x@info$identity,
  character(1)
)

cat("\nTelemetry objects create<LOCAL_PATH>")
print(length(tele_list))

# Metadata table to join back later
seg_metadata <- akde_df %>%
  distinct(
    seg_key,
    id,
    hr_season_year,
    hr_season,
    Sex,
    `CWD Status`
  )

# =============================================================================
# 3) Process one article seasonal seg_key
# =============================================================================

process_segkey <- function(seg_id) {

  tel <- tele_list[[seg_id]]

  if (is.null(tel) || nrow(tel) < min_fixes) {
    return(list(area = tibble(), uds = list()))
  }

  # seconds
  tmin   <- min(tel$t, na.rm = TRUE)
  tmax   <- max(tel$t, na.rm = TRUE)
  winlen <- as.numeric(win_days) * 24 * 3600
  step   <- as.numeric(step_days) * 24 * 3600

  # safety rails
  if (!is.finite(tmin) || !is.finite(tmax) || !is.finite(winlen) || !is.finite(step)) {
    return(list(area = tibble(), uds = list()))
  }

  if (step <= 0) {
    stop("step_days must be > 0")
  }

  # If the seasonal segment is shorter than the window, skip
  if ((tmax - tmin) < winlen) {
    return(list(area = tibble(), uds = list()))
  }

  # Build window starts
  last_start <- tmax - winlen

  starts <- if (last_start >= tmin) {
    seq(from = tmin, to = last_start, by = step)
  } else {
    numeric(0)
  }

  if (length(starts) == 0) {
    return(list(area = tibble(), uds = list()))
  }

  area_rows <- tibble()
  ud_list   <- list()

  for (t0 in starts) {

    t1 <- t0 + winlen

    win <- tel[tel$t >= t0 & tel$t <= t1, ]

    if (nrow(win) < min_fixes) next

    UDw <- tryCatch(
      {
        v0 <- ctmm::variogram(win, CI = "Gauss")
        vf <- ctmm::variogram.fit(v0, name = "GuessBM", interactive = FALSE)
        m0 <- ctmm::ctmm.select(win, vf, IC = "BIC")
        ctmm::akde(win, m0, weights = TRUE)
      },
      error = function(e) {
        return(NULL)
      }
    )

    if (is.null(UDw)) next

    key <- paste0(seg_id, "___", as.integer(t0))
    ud_list[[key]] <- UDw

    ci <- tryCatch(
      summary(UDw)$CI,
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    if (is.null(ci)) next

    ci_tbl <- as_tibble(ci, rownames = "unit")

    a <- ci_tbl %>%
      dplyr::filter(startsWith(unit, "area")) %>%
      dplyr::select(low, est, high)

    if (nrow(a) == 0) next

    area_rows <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      area_rows,
      tibble(
        seg_key = seg_id,
        window_start = as.POSIXct(t0, origin = "1970-01-01", tz = tz_analysis),
        window_end   = as.POSIXct(t1, origin = "1970-01-01", tz = tz_analysis),
        low = a$low,
        est = a$est,
        high = a$high
      )
    )
  }

  list(area = area_rows, uds = ud_list)
}

# =============================================================================
# 4) Run in parallel
# =============================================================================

plan(multisession, workers = max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1))

seg_ids <- names(tele_list)

seg_results <- furrr::future_map(
  seg_ids,
  process_segkey,
  .progress = TRUE,
  .options = furrr::furrr_options(seed = TRUE)
)

names(seg_results) <- seg_ids

# =============================================================================
# 5) Collect outputs
# =============================================================================

segwin_area_df <- purrr::map_dfr(seg_results, "area")

segwin_ud_list_by_segkey <- purrr::map(seg_results, "uds")

# Add article metadata back
segwin_area_df <- segwin_area_df %>%
  left_join(seg_metadata, by = "seg_key") %>%
  arrange(id, hr_season_year, hr_season, window_start)

# =============================================================================
# 6) Area unit handling
#
# ctmm area units can vary depending on summary output.
# First inspect values before converting.
# =============================================================================

cat("\nAKDE area output previe<LOCAL_PATH>")
segwin_area_df %>%
  select(seg_key, id, hr_season_year, hr_season, window_start, low, est, high) %>%
  head(20) %>%
  print()

# If you confirm ctmm returns hectares, convert to km² like this:
# segwin_area_df <- segwin_area_df %>%
#   mutate(
#     low_km2  = low / 100,
#     est_km2  = est / 100,
#     high_km2 = high / 100
#   )

# If values are already km², use:
segwin_area_df <- segwin_area_df %>%
  mutate(
    low_km2  = low,
    est_km2  = est,
    high_km2 = high
  )

# =============================================================================
# 7) Save and quick sanity checks
# =============================================================================

readr::write_csv(
  segwin_area_df,
  file.path(ARTICLE_OUT_DIR, "sliding_window_akde_area_by_article_season.csv")
)

cat("\nWindows per article seasonal seg_ke<LOCAL_PATH>")
segwin_area_df %>%
  group_by(seg_key, id, hr_season_year, hr_season) %>%
  summarise(
    n_windows = n(),
    mean_est_km2 = mean(est_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_est_km2 = median(est_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_windows)) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

cat("\n✅ Sliding-window AKDE complete.\n")
cat("Saved t<LOCAL_PATH>")
cat(file.path(ARTICLE_OUT_DIR, "sliding_window_akde_area_by_article_season.csv"), "\n")

segwin_area_df
```

## starting here again (reload everything)

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# RELOAD SAVED SLIDING-WINDOW AKDE OUTPUTS
# Use this when AKDE already ran and you do NOT want to rerun it
# =============================================================================

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(lubridate)
library(tibble)
library(stringr)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Params must match the AKDE run
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
ARTICLE_OUT_DIR <- "<LOCAL_PATH>"
win_days    <- 7
step_days   <- 1
tz_analysis <- "UTC"

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Required paths
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

akde_input_path <- file.path(
  ARTICLE_OUT_DIR,
  "akde_article_seasonal_input.csv"
)

akde_area_path <- file.path(
  ARTICLE_OUT_DIR,
  "sliding_window_akde_area_by_article_season.csv"
)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Safety checks
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (!file.exists(akde_area_path)) {
  stop(
    "Could not find saved AKDE area fil<LOCAL_PATH>",
    akde_area_path,
    "\n\nYou may need to check ARTICLE_OUT_DIR or confirm the AKDE chunk finished saving."
  )
}

if (!file.exists(akde_input_path)) {
  warning(
    "Could not find saved AKDE input fil<LOCAL_PATH>",
    akde_input_path,
    "\n\nContinuing with the AKDE area file only."
  )
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Reload saved AKDE area output
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

segwin_area_df <- readr::read_csv(
  akde_area_path,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Normalize date/time columns
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

segwin_area_df <- segwin_area_df %>%
  mutate(
    window_start = as.POSIXct(window_start, tz = tz_analysis),
    window_end = if ("window_end" %in% names(.)) {
      as.POSIXct(window_end, tz = tz_analysis)
    } else {
      window_start + lubridate::days(win_days)
    }
  )

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Rebuild km2 columns if needed
#
# Your AKDE code treated low/est/high as already km²:
#   low_km2  = low
#   est_km2  = est
#   high_km2 = high
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

segwin_area_df <- segwin_area_df %>%
  mutate(
    low_km2  = if ("low_km2"  %in% names(.)) low_km2  else low,
    est_km2  = if ("est_km2"  %in% names(.)) est_km2  else est,
    high_km2 = if ("high_km2" %in% names(.)) high_km2 else high
  )

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Reload AKDE input and metadata if available
# This is useful if metadata columns were missing or got changed during save/load
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (file.exists(akde_input_path)) {

  akde_df <- readr::read_csv(
    akde_input_path,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      id = as.character(id),
      hr_season = as.character(hr_season),
      hr_season_year = as.integer(hr_season_year),
      date = as.POSIXct(date, tz = tz_analysis),
      seg_key = as.character(seg_key)
    )

  seg_metadata <- akde_df %>%
    distinct(
      seg_key,
      id,
      hr_season_year,
      hr_season,
      Sex,
      `CWD Status`
    )

  # Only join metadata columns if they are missing or incomplete
  segwin_area_df <- segwin_area_df %>%
    mutate(seg_key = as.character(seg_key)) %>%
    select(
      -any_of(c("id", "hr_season_year", "hr_season", "Sex", "CWD Status"))
    ) %>%
    left_join(seg_metadata, by = "seg_key")

} else {

  akde_df <- NULL

  seg_metadata <- segwin_area_df %>%
    distinct(
      seg_key,
      id,
      hr_season_year,
      hr_season,
      Sex,
      `CWD Status`
    )
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Final ordering
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

segwin_area_df <- segwin_area_df %>%
  arrange(id, hr_season_year, hr_season, window_start)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# QA: confirm reload worked
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\n✅ Reloaded saved sliding-window AKDE area output.\n")
cat("File loaded fro<LOCAL_PATH>")
cat(akde_area_path, "\n\n")

cat("Rows loaded:", nrow(segwin_area_df), "\n")
cat("Unique article seasonal seg_keys:", dplyr::n_distinct(segwin_area_df$seg_key), "\n\n")

cat("Previe<LOCAL_PATH>")
segwin_area_df %>%
  select(
    seg_key,
    id,
    hr_season_year,
    hr_season,
    window_start,
    window_end,
    low,
    est,
    high,
    low_km2,
    est_km2,
    high_km2
  ) %>%
  head(20) %>%
  print()

cat("\nWindows per article seasonal seg_ke<LOCAL_PATH>")
segwin_area_df %>%
  group_by(seg_key, id, hr_season_year, hr_season) %>%
  summarise(
    n_windows = n(),
    mean_est_km2 = mean(est_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_est_km2 = median(est_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_windows)) %>%
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# Attach saved sliding-window AKDE values back onto point-level article data
# WITHOUT rerunning AKDE
# =============================================================================

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(lubridate)
library(tidyr)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Params
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

win_days    <- 7
tz_analysis <- "UTC"

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Reload point-level AKDE input if needed
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (!exists("akde_df")) {

  akde_input_path <- file.path(
    ARTICLE_OUT_DIR,
    "akde_article_seasonal_input.csv"
  )

  if (!file.exists(akde_input_path)) {
    stop(
      "akde_df is not in memory and the saved AKDE input file was not foun<LOCAL_PATH>",
      akde_input_path
    )
  }

  akde_df <- readr::read_csv(
    akde_input_path,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      id = as.character(id),
      hr_season = as.character(hr_season),
      hr_season_year = as.integer(hr_season_year),
      seg_key = as.character(seg_key),
      date = as.POSIXct(date, tz = tz_analysis)
    )
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Reload sliding-window AKDE area results if needed
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (!exists("segwin_area_df")) {

  akde_area_path <- file.path(
    ARTICLE_OUT_DIR,
    "sliding_window_akde_area_by_article_season.csv"
  )

  if (!file.exists(akde_area_path)) {
    stop(
      "segwin_area_df is not in memory and the saved AKDE area file was not foun<LOCAL_PATH>",
      akde_area_path
    )
  }

  segwin_area_df <- readr::read_csv(
    akde_area_path,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Normalize time columns
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

akde_df <- akde_df %>%
  mutate(
    seg_key = as.character(seg_key),
    date = as.POSIXct(date, tz = tz_analysis)
  )

segwin_area_df <- segwin_area_df %>%
  mutate(
    seg_key = as.character(seg_key),
    window_start = as.POSIXct(window_start, tz = tz_analysis),
    window_end = if ("window_end" %in% names(.)) {
      as.POSIXct(window_end, tz = tz_analysis)
    } else {
      window_start + lubridate::days(win_days)
    },
    low_km2 = if ("low_km2" %in% names(.)) low_km2 else low,
    est_km2 = if ("est_km2" %in% names(.)) est_km2 else est,
    high_km2 = if ("high_km2" %in% names(.)) high_km2 else high
  )

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Make sure 7-day moving average columns exist
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (!all(c("akde_est_7d", "akde_low_7d", "akde_high_7d") %in% names(segwin_area_df))) {

  library(slider)

  segwin_area_df <- segwin_area_df %>%
    arrange(seg_key, window_start) %>%
    group_by(seg_key) %>%
    mutate(
      akde_est_7d = slide_index_dbl(
        est_km2,
        window_start,
        ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        .before = days(6),
        .complete = TRUE
      ),
      akde_low_7d = slide_index_dbl(
        low_km2,
        window_start,
        ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        .before = days(6),
        .complete = TRUE
      ),
      akde_high_7d = slide_index_dbl(
        high_km2,
        window_start,
        ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        .before = days(6),
        .complete = TRUE
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Attach each GPS point to the most recent AKDE window_start
#
# Logic:
# Each AKDE window represents the 7-day area from:
#   window_start through window_end
#
# For each GPS fix, attach the AKDE window where:
#   date >= window_start and date <= window_end
#
# Since windows overlap, a GPS fix can fall into multiple windows.
# To avoid duplicated rows, we keep the most recent window_start for each fix.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

akde_points_with_area <- akde_df %>%
  mutate(.rid = row_number()) %>%
  select(-any_of(c(
    "low", "est", "high",
    "low_km2", "est_km2", "high_km2",
    "akde_est_7d", "akde_low_7d", "akde_high_7d",
    "akde_window_start", "akde_window_end"
  ))) %>%
  left_join(
    segwin_area_df %>%
      select(
        seg_key,
        window_start,
        window_end,
        low,
        est,
        high,
        low_km2,
        est_km2,
        high_km2,
        akde_est_7d,
        akde_low_7d,
        akde_high_7d
      ),
    by = "seg_key",
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    is.na(window_start) |
      (date >= window_start & date <= window_end)
  ) %>%
  group_by(.rid) %>%
  arrange(desc(window_start), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rename(
    akde_window_start = window_start,
    akde_window_end = window_end
  ) %>%
  arrange(seg_key, date)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Diagnostics
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\nRows in original akde_df:", nrow(akde_df), "\n")
cat("Rows after AKDE join:", nrow(akde_points_with_area), "\n")
cat("Rows with AKDE est_km2:", sum(!is.na(akde_points_with_area$est_km2)), "\n")
cat("Rows without AKDE est_km2:", sum(is.na(akde_points_with_area$est_km2)), "\n\n")

cat("Previe<LOCAL_PATH>")
akde_points_with_area %>%
  select(
    seg_key,
    id,
    hr_season_year,
    hr_season,
    date,
    akde_window_start,
    akde_window_end,
    est_km2,
    akde_est_7d
  ) %>%
  head(20) %>%
  print()

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Save point-level file with attached sliding-window AKDE values
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

readr::write_csv(
  akde_points_with_area,
  file.path(ARTICLE_OUT_DIR, "article_points_with_sliding_window_akde.csv")
)

readr::write_csv(
  akde_points_with_area,
  "<LOCAL_PATH>"
)

readr::write_csv(
  akde_points_with_area,
  "<LOCAL_PATH>"
)

cat("\n✅ Saved point-level dataset with sliding-window AKDE attached.\n")
cat("Saved t<LOCAL_PATH>")
cat(file.path(ARTICLE_OUT_DIR, "article_points_with_sliding_window_akde.csv"), "\n")
cat("<LOCAL_PATH>")
cat("<LOCAL_PATH>")
```

```{r}
      window_start + lubridate::days(win_days)
    },
    low_km2 = if ("low_km2" %in% names(.)) low_km2 else low,
    est_km2 = if ("est_km2" %in% names(.)) est_km2 else est,
    high_km2 = if ("high_km2" %in% names(.)) high_km2 else high
  )

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Inspect columns
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

colnames(akde_df)
colnames(segwin_area_df)

# Identify any old AKDE-related columns on the point-level data
akde_cols <- grep(
  "^akde_|area_poly_km2|^low$|^est$|^high$|^low_km2$|^est_km2$|^high_km2$",
  names(akde_df),
  value = TRUE
)

akde_cols

# Drop old AKDE columns from point-level data before rejoining cleanly
akde_df <- akde_df %>%
  select(-any_of(akde_cols))

# Sanity check
grep(
  "^akde_|area_poly_km2|^low$|^est$|^high$|^low_km2$|^est_km2$|^high_km2$",
  names(akde_df),
  value = TRUE
)

# Save the AKDE window-level output
readr::write_csv(
  segwin_area_df,
  "<LOCAL_PATH>"
)
```


```{r}
# =============================================================================
# Join sliding-window AKDE results back to article point-level data
# =============================================================================

library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(lubridate)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Make sure 7-day moving average columns exist
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (!all(c("akde_est_7d", "akde_low_7d", "akde_high_7d") %in% names(segwin_area_df))) {

  library(slider)

  segwin_area_df <- segwin_area_df %>%
    arrange(seg_key, window_start) %>%
    group_by(seg_key) %>%
    mutate(
      akde_est_7d = slide_index_dbl(
        est_km2,
        window_start,
        ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        .before = days(6),
        .complete = TRUE
      ),
      akde_low_7d = slide_index_dbl(
        low_km2,
        window_start,
        ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        .before = days(6),
        .complete = TRUE
      ),
      akde_high_7d = slide_index_dbl(
        high_km2,
        window_start,
        ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        .before = days(6),
        .complete = TRUE
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Prepare data.table objects
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

akde_df_dt <- as.data.table(akde_df)

akde_df_dt[, date := as.POSIXct(date, tz = "UTC")]
akde_df_dt[, .rid := .I]

win_dt <- as.data.table(segwin_area_df)

win_dt[, `:=`(
  window_start = as.POSIXct(window_start, tz = "UTC"),
  window_end   = as.POSIXct(window_end,   tz = "UTC")
)]

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Keep only columns needed for interval overlap
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

pts <- akde_df_dt[, .(
  seg_key,
  date_start = date,
  date_end = date,
  .rid
)]

wins <- win_dt[, .(
  seg_key,
  window_start,
  window_end,
  low,
  est,
  high,
  low_km2,
  est_km2,
  high_km2,
  akde_est_7d,
  akde_low_7d,
  akde_high_7d
)]

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Interval join:
# point date must fall within AKDE window_start/window_end
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

setkey(wins, seg_key, window_start, window_end)
setkey(pts,  seg_key, date_start,   date_end)

ov <- foverlaps(
  pts,
  wins,
  by.x = c("seg_key", "date_start", "date_end"),
  by.y = c("seg_key", "window_start", "window_end"),
  type = "within",
  nomatch = NA
)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Because windows overlap, a GPS point can match multiple windows.
#
# Keep the most recent window_start for each point.
# This means each point receives the most up-to-date AKDE window that contains it.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (anyDuplicated(ov$.rid)) {
  setorder(ov, .rid, -window_start)
  ov <- ov[!duplicated(.rid)]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Merge AKDE stats back onto full point-level table
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

akde_points_with_area <- merge(
  akde_df_dt,
  ov[, .(
    .rid,
    akde_window_start = window_start,
    akde_window_end = window_end,
    low,
    est,
    high,
    low_km2,
    est_km2,
    high_km2,
    akde_est_7d,
    akde_low_7d,
    akde_high_7d
  )],
  by = ".rid",
  all.x = TRUE
)[, .rid := NULL][]

akde_points_with_area <- as_tibble(akde_points_with_area) %>%
  arrange(seg_key, date)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Sanity checks
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\nRows in akde_df:", nrow(akde_df), "\n")
cat("Rows after AKDE join:", nrow(akde_points_with_area), "\n")
cat("Rows with est_km2:", sum(!is.na(akde_points_with_area$est_km2)), "\n")
cat("Rows missing est_km2:", sum(is.na(akde_points_with_area$est_km2)), "\n\n")

akde_points_with_area %>%
  select(
    seg_key,
    id,
    hr_season_year,
    hr_season,
    date,
    akde_window_start,
    akde_window_end,
    est_km2,
    akde_est_7d
  ) %>%
  head(20) %>%
  print()

# Optional save after AKDE join
readr::write_csv(
  akde_points_with_area,
  file.path(ARTICLE_OUT_DIR, "article_points_with_sliding_window_akde.csv")
)


head(akde_points_with_area)
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# Add movement features to point-level article-season AKDE dataset
# =============================================================================

library(dplyr)
library(slider)
library(moments)
library(readr)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper: windowed sinuosity on x/y coords
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

calc_windowed_sinuosity <- function(easting, northing) {

  if (length(easting) < 2 || length(northing) < 2) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  net_disp <- sqrt(
    (easting[length(easting)] - easting[1])^2 +
      (northing[length(northing)] - northing[1])^2
  )

  total_dist <- sum(
    sqrt(diff(easting)^2 + diff(northing)^2),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  if (!is.finite(total_dist) || total_dist == 0) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  net_disp / total_dist
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Add features
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

deer_AKDE_Final <- akde_points_with_area %>%
  arrange(id, date) %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  mutate(
    abs_rel_angle = abs(rel.angle),

    # dt from adehabitatLT is in seconds; dist is in meters if x/y are UTM
    velo = ifelse(
      is.finite(dt) & dt > 0,
      dist / dt,
      NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Sinuosity over current point + previous 27 fixes
    sinuosity_28pt = slide_dbl(
      .x = seq_along(date),
      .f = function(i) {
        i0 <- max(1L, i - 27L)
        i1 <- i
        calc_windowed_sinuosity(x[i0:i1], y[i0:i1])
      },
      .before = 0,
      .after = 0,
      .complete = FALSE
    ),

    # Rolling abs rel angle stats
    rolling_abs_rel_angle_mean = slide_dbl(
      abs_rel_angle,
      ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
      .before = 27,
      .after = 0,
      .complete = FALSE
    ),
    rolling_abs_rel_angle_var = slide_dbl(
      abs_rel_angle,
      ~ var(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
      .before = 27,
      .after = 0,
      .complete = FALSE
    ),
    rolling_abs_rel_angle_sd = slide_dbl(
      abs_rel_angle,
      ~ sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
      .before = 27,
      .after = 0,
      .complete = FALSE
    ),
    rolling_abs_rel_angle_skew = slide_dbl(
      abs_rel_angle,
      ~ moments::skewness(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
      .before = 27,
      .after = 0,
      .complete = FALSE
    ),
    rolling_abs_rel_angle_kurt = slide_dbl(
      abs_rel_angle,
      ~ moments::kurtosis(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
      .before = 27,
      .after = 0,
      .complete = FALSE
    ),

    # Rolling velocity stats
    rolling_velo_mean = slide_dbl(
      velo,
      ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
      .before = 27,
      .after = 0,
      .complete = FALSE
    ),
    rolling_velo_var = slide_dbl(
      velo,
      ~ var(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
      .before = 27,
      .after = 0,
      .complete = FALSE
    ),
    rolling_velo_sd = slide_dbl(
      velo,
      ~ sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
      .before = 27,
      .after = 0,
      .complete = FALSE
    ),
    rolling_velo_skew = slide_dbl(
      velo,
      ~ moments::skewness(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
      .before = 27,
      .after = 0,
      .complete = FALSE
    ),
    rolling_velo_kurt = slide_dbl(
      velo,
      ~ moments::kurtosis(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
      .before = 27,
      .after = 0,
      .complete = FALSE
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Join status metadata only if status_final2 exists
# Otherwise keep Sex / CWD Status already present from akde_df
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (exists("status_final2")) {

  cat("\nstatus_final2 found. Joining status metadata from status_final2.\n")

  status_final2_clean <- status_final2 %>%
    mutate(AID = as.character(AID)) %>%
    distinct(AID, .keep_all = TRUE)

  deer_AKDE_Final <- deer_AKDE_Final %>%
    select(-any_of(c("Sex", "CWD Status", "year_final"))) %>%
    mutate(id = as.character(id)) %>%
    left_join(
      status_final2_clean %>%
        select(AID, Sex, `CWD Status`, year_final),
      by = c("id" = "AID")
    )

} else {

  cat("\nstatus_final2 not found. Keeping Sex / CWD Status already present in deer_AKDE_Final.\n")

  # Add year_final as NA if it does not exist, so later code does not break
  if (!"year_final" %in% names(deer_AKDE_Final)) {
    deer_AKDE_Final <- deer_AKDE_Final %>%
      mutate(year_final = NA_integer_)
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Final diagnostics
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\nFinal column<LOCAL_PATH>")
print(colnames(deer_AKDE_Final))

cat("\nAKDE coverag<LOCAL_PATH>")
cat("Rows:", nrow(deer_AKDE_Final), "\n")
cat("Rows with est_km2:", sum(!is.na(deer_AKDE_Final$est_km2)), "\n")
cat("Rows missing est_km2:", sum(is.na(deer_AKDE_Final$est_km2)), "\n")

cat("\nCWD status summar<LOCAL_PATH>")
if ("CWD Status" %in% names(deer_AKDE_Final)) {
  deer_AKDE_Final %>%
    count(`CWD Status`, sort = TRUE) %>%
    print()
} else {
  cat("No `CWD Status` column found.\n")
}

cat("\nSex summar<LOCAL_PATH>")
if ("Sex" %in% names(deer_AKDE_Final)) {
  deer_AKDE_Final %>%
    count(Sex, sort = TRUE) %>%
    print()
} else {
  cat("No `Sex` column found.\n")
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Save final output
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

readr::write_csv(
  deer_AKDE_Final,
  "<LOCAL_PATH>"
)

readr::write_csv(
  deer_AKDE_Final,
  "<LOCAL_PATH>"
)

readr::write_csv(
  deer_AKDE_Final,
  file.path(ARTICLE_OUT_DIR, "deer_AKDE_Final_article_seasonal.csv")
)

cat("\n✅ Saved final deer AKDE file.\n")
cat("<LOCAL_PATH>")
cat("<LOCAL_PATH>")
cat(file.path(ARTICLE_OUT_DIR, "deer_AKDE_Final_article_seasonal.csv"), "\n")

head(deer_AKDE_Final)
```
