```{r}
# =============================================================================
# Create train/test datasets from final AKDE + movement dataset
#
# Logic:
#   - Start from deer_AKDE_Final
#   - Remove rows where AKDE est/high are > 100
#   - Preserve all columns, including seasons, AKDE columns, and movement features
#   - Any ID that is ever CWD-positive goes to TEST
#   - IDs that are never CWD-positive go to TRAIN
# =============================================================================

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(readr)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Settings
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

threshold <- 100

out_dir <- "<LOCAL_PATH>"
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Start from final joined dataset
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (!exists("deer_AKDE_Final")) {
  stop("deer_AKDE_Final does not exist. Load or create it before running this chunk.")
}

df <- deer_AKDE_Final

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Basic checks
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (!"id" %in% names(df)) {
  stop("No `id` column found in deer_AKDE_Final.")
}

if (!"est" %in% names(df)) {
  stop("No `est` column found in deer_AKDE_Final.")
}

if (!"high" %in% names(df)) {
  stop("No `high` column found in deer_AKDE_Final.")
}

cat("\nRows before AKDE filtering:", nrow(df), "\n")
cat("Unique IDs before AKDE filtering:", n_distinct(df$id, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# AKDE removal summary
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

akde_removal_summary <- df %>%
  summarize(
    total_rows = n(),
    rows_above_100_est = sum(est > threshold, na.rm = TRUE),
    rows_above_100_high = sum(high > threshold, na.rm = TRUE),
    rows_est_or_high_above_100 = sum(est > threshold | high > threshold, na.rm = TRUE),
    rows_at_or_below_100 = sum(est <= threshold & high <= threshold, na.rm = TRUE),
    rows_missing_est = sum(is.na(est)),
    rows_missing_high = sum(is.na(high)),
    pct_removed = 100 * rows_est_or_high_above_100 / total_rows
  )

cat("\nAKDE removal summar<LOCAL_PATH>")
print(akde_removal_summary)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Save rows above threshold for inspection
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

AKDE_above_100 <- df %>%
  filter(
    is.na(est) |
      is.na(high) |
      est > threshold |
      high > threshold
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(est))

cat("\nRows removed or missing AKDE value<LOCAL_PATH>")
print(AKDE_above_100)

readr::write_csv(
  AKDE_above_100,
  file.path(out_dir, "AKDE_removed_above_100_or_missing.csv")
)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Apply AKDE filter
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

AKDE_df_under_100 <- df %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(est),
    !is.na(high),
    est <= threshold,
    high <= threshold
  )

# Use filtered AKDE dataset as the active dataset moving forward
AKDE_df <- AKDE_df_under_100

cat("\nRows after AKDE filtering:", nrow(AKDE_df), "\n")
cat("Unique IDs after AKDE filtering:", n_distinct(AKDE_df$id, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

# Save filtered checkpoint
readr::write_csv(
  AKDE_df,
  file.path(out_dir, "deer_AKDE_Final_under_100.csv")
)

readr::write_csv(
  AKDE_df,
  "<LOCAL_PATH>"
)

cat("\n✅ Saved filtered AKDE checkpoints.\n")
cat(file.path(out_dir, "deer_AKDE_Final_under_100.csv"), "\n")
cat("<LOCAL_PATH>")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Continue train/test split from filtered AKDE dataframe
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

df <- AKDE_df

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# If CWD Status is missing but status_final2 exists, join status metadata
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (!"CWD Status" %in% names(df) && exists("status_final2")) {

  cat("\n`CWD Status` not found. Joining from status_final2.\n")

  status_final2_clean <- status_final2 %>%
    mutate(AID = as.character(AID)) %>%
    distinct(AID, .keep_all = TRUE)

  df <- df %>%
    mutate(id = as.character(id)) %>%
    left_join(
      status_final2_clean %>%
        select(AID, Sex, `CWD Status`, year_final),
      by = c("id" = "AID")
    )

} else if ("CWD Status" %in% names(df)) {

  cat("\n`CWD Status` found. Using existing status column.\n")

} else {

  stop("No `CWD Status` column found, and status_final2 does not exist.")
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Label checks
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\nRows before labeling:", nrow(df), "\n")
cat("Unique IDs before labeling:", n_distinct(df$id, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Rows missing ID:", sum(is.na(df$id)), "\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Normalize CWD status values
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

df_labeled <- df %>%
  mutate(
    id = as.character(id),
    CWD_status_std = str_to_lower(str_trim(as.character(`CWD Status`))),
    CWD_status_std = case_when(
      CWD_status_std %in% c(
        "positive", "pos", "+", "cwd+", "cwd positive", "cwd-positive"
      ) ~ "positive",

      CWD_status_std %in% c(
        "negative", "neg", "-", "cwd-", "cwd negative", "cwd-negative"
      ) ~ "negative",

      TRUE ~ CWD_status_std
    )
  )

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Keep only clearly labeled positive/negative rows
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

df_labeled <- df_labeled %>%
  filter(CWD_status_std %in% c("positive", "negative"))

cat("\nRows after keeping labeled positive/negative rows:", nrow(df_labeled), "\n")
cat("Unique IDs after labeling:", n_distinct(df_labeled$id, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

cat("\nCWD status summary after standardizatio<LOCAL_PATH>")
df_labeled %>%
  count(CWD_status_std, sort = TRUE) %>%
  print()

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Split by ID:
# Any deer that is ever positive goes to TEST.
# Never-positive deer go to TRAIN.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

pos_ids <- df_labeled %>%
  filter(CWD_status_std == "positive") %>%
  distinct(id) %>%
  pull(id)

test_df <- df_labeled %>%
  filter(id %in% pos_ids)

train_df <- df_labeled %>%
  filter(!id %in% pos_ids)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Sanity checks
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\nTRAIN — rows:", nrow(train_df),
    " | unique IDs:", n_distinct(train_df$id), "\n")

cat("TEST  — rows:", nrow(test_df),
    " | unique IDs:", n_distinct(test_df$id), "\n")

cat("\nTRAIN status summar<LOCAL_PATH>")
train_df %>%
  count(CWD_status_std, sort = TRUE) %>%
  print()

cat("\nTEST status summar<LOCAL_PATH>")
test_df %>%
  count(CWD_status_std, sort = TRUE) %>%
  print()

ids_in_both <- intersect(unique(train_df$id), unique(test_df$id))

cat("\nIDs in both train and test:", length(ids_in_both), "\n")

stopifnot(length(ids_in_both) == 0)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Check that AKDE columns survived
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

required_akde_cols <- c("low", "est", "high")

optional_akde_cols <- c(
  "low_km2",
  "est_km2",
  "high_km2",
  "akde_est_7d",
  "akde_low_7d",
  "akde_high_7d"
)

missing_required_akde_cols <- setdiff(required_akde_cols, names(df_labeled))

if (length(missing_required_akde_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "The following required AKDE columns are missing from df_labeled: ",
    paste(missing_required_akde_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

cat("\n✅ Required AKDE columns preserve<LOCAL_PATH>")
print(required_akde_cols)

cat("\nOptional AKDE columns presen<LOCAL_PATH>")
print(intersect(optional_akde_cols, names(df_labeled)))

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Check that movement feature columns survived
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

movement_cols <- c(
  "abs_rel_angle",
  "velo",
  "sinuosity_28pt",
  "rolling_abs_rel_angle_mean",
  "rolling_abs_rel_angle_sd",
  "rolling_velo_mean",
  "rolling_velo_sd"
)

present_movement_cols <- intersect(movement_cols, names(df_labeled))
missing_movement_cols <- setdiff(movement_cols, names(df_labeled))

cat("\nMovement columns presen<LOCAL_PATH>")
print(present_movement_cols)

if (length(missing_movement_cols) > 0) {
  cat("\nMovement columns missin<LOCAL_PATH>")
  print(missing_movement_cols)
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Check that season columns survived
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

season_cols <- c(
  "hr_season",
  "hr_season_year",
  "activity_season",
  "activity_season_year",
  "seg_key"
)

present_season_cols <- intersect(season_cols, names(df_labeled))
missing_season_cols <- setdiff(season_cols, names(df_labeled))

cat("\nSeason columns presen<LOCAL_PATH>")
print(present_season_cols)

if (length(missing_season_cols) > 0) {
  cat("\nSeason columns missin<LOCAL_PATH>")
  print(missing_season_cols)
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Save train/test files
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

write_csv(
  train_df,
  file.path(out_dir, "deer_train_negative.csv")
)

write_csv(
  test_df,
  file.path(out_dir, "deer_test_positive.csv")
)

# Also save labeled full filtered dataframe
write_csv(
  df_labeled,
  file.path(out_dir, "deer_AKDE_Final_under_100_labeled.csv")
)

cat("\n✅ Saved train/test file<LOCAL_PATH>")
cat(file.path(out_dir, "deer_train_negative.csv"), "\n")
cat(file.path(out_dir, "deer_test_positive.csv"), "\n")
cat(file.path(out_dir, "deer_AKDE_Final_under_100_labeled.csv"), "\n")
```
